preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and n > 0 for n in nums)
preconditions.description: All input arguments are positive integers.
At least one integer is provided.

postconditions.expression: max_width == max(len(str(n)) for n in nums)
postconditions.description: The width used for formatting equals the number of digits in the largest integer.
The returned string consists of each integer formatted with leading zeros to match the maximum width, separated by newlines.
